metadata.description: Generate social media cover images (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, WeChat) as 1080x1440 PNGs by writing HTML and screenshotting with Chrome — not AI image generation. Exact Chinese text, precise logos, real product screenshots inside device mockups.
